messages:
maria (Support): Hey team — Escalation from ACME Corp. Their mobile analytics page in Compact layout is showing missing legend items and tooltips pulling values from the wrong series. Customer says this started after this morning's frontend deploy. Screenshot: https://redwood.s3.amazonaws.com/esc/acme-legend-gap.png :grimacing:
jack (Eng-Frontend): Can you paste repro steps and device/browser info?
maria (Support): Repro steps I got from ACME:
1) Log in as ACME-test user
2) Console > Analytics > Product Usage
3) Switch to Compact (mobile) layout (~360px)
4) Tap the small line chart in the first row
Observed: legend only lists 2 of 4 series, labels shifted vs colors. Tooltip shows the top series value for every entry.
Devices: iPhone SE (2020) iOS 15, Pixel 4a Android 12 (both reported)
ingrid (Product): Impact? They say 3 dashboards affected, two teams blocked. Asking for P1.
sam (Eng-Mobile): I'll try repro on a Pixel 4a. Any console logs or network traces from ACME?
maria (Support): Their console excerpt:
```
Unhandled promise rejection TypeError: Cannot read property 'length' of undefined at Legend.render (legend.js:142)
```
Network tab shows the chart payload has all 4 series, but UI renders only 2.
jack (Eng-Frontend): Hmm looks like a rendering sync issue — legend built from DOM/visible nodes while series array mutates post-render. Suspect a race with virtualization + CSS transforms. Quick pseudo-theory:
```
const items = this.props.series || []
// somewhere later items.splice(...) mutates original array
```
Index-color mapping drifts if array mutated in place.
maria (Support): Deploy log shows frontend rc/1890 deployed at 1812345000 by jack
deploy-bot: Release rc/1890 deployed to prod at 1812345000. Feature flag new-compact-legend=true
jack (Eng-Frontend): Try repro with the flag off. If that's it, we can toggle the flag quickly.
sam (Eng-Mobile): I repro'd on Pixel 4a with new-compact-legend=true — same failure. Flag off -> appears correct. Assigning to myself to trace deeper.
sre-bot: Note: metrics-ingest reported slight backpressure 1812344200-1812344800 — but payloads were delivered; seems unrelated to missing legend items.
ingrid (Product): Customer wants ETA. Can we get a rollback today?
jack (Eng-Frontend): If it's the A/B path, I can flip the flag now and follow up with a patch tomorrow. Will open a rollback toggle PR.
maria (Support): ACME agreed to immediate flag disable. I'll send the update once it's off.
sam (Eng-Mobile): Root cause: virtualization + `transform: translateZ(0)` + `overflow: hidden` on the widget caused inconsistent reflow in Android WebView; combined with in-place mutation of the series array so the legend indices no longer matched series ids. Plan: stop mutating arrays (use slice/map), add index->id mapping, and add unit + integration tests for compact layout.
jack (Eng-Frontend): Also adding a defensive check in Legend.render to map by series id if positions mismatch.
maria (Support): Action items:
- jack: flip new-compact-legend flag off (owner)
- sam: patch to avoid in-place mutation and add unit test (owner)
- jack: run canary on iOS/Android compact embeds after flag change
- maria: confirm with ACME and close the ticket
:thumbsup:
